title: Tex and the spaghetti sandwich
summary: Labat tells a humorous story of the saxophonist Tex getting drunk at a Saturday dinner.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: One Saturday he came over here to play with my band, with me and we had meatballs and spaghetti for dinner. Tex got drunk and left out there with a spaghetti sandwich. I knew I was trying to go out there. That was one of my biggest spaghetti sandwich in my life. That's a new one on me.

He went back a time where all that whiskey was, that bootleg liquor was there, you know, and he ripped his pants on the side for you to clean on down there out there. We'll get to come back here with his pants ripped.
He was a good saxophone player too.
He played that good baritone horn.
